facts: All new code is in the CLI package `cli/` (package @ivotoby/postgram-cli, ESM). Source files are under cli/src/tracking/, tests under cli/tests/unit/. The CLI never imports from the server package `src/`.

tsconfig (cli/tsconfig.json) is strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes and verbatimModuleSyntax, module NodeNext: EVERY relative import ends in .js, in source and tests (for example `import { shq } from '../../src/tracking/config.js'` from cli/tests/unit). Use `import type` for type-only imports (consistent-type-imports).
exactOptionalPropertyTypes: an optional key typed `key?: T` does not accept `T | undefined`. Add a key only when its value is defined (`...(v !== undefined ? { key: v } : {})`); do not cast.

ESLint (typescript-eslint recommendedTypeChecked) runs with zero allowed warnings. In cli/src no-unsafe-assignment, no-unsafe-member-access, no-unsafe-argument and require-await are off, but they are ON in cli/tests: in tests type JSON.parse results (`JSON.parse(text) as { a: string }`) and do not mark a function async unless it awaits. no-floating-promises is on everywhere: await or `void` every promise. Never call String() on an unknown value; narrow it with typeof first.

Node built-ins only (node:fs, node:fs/promises, node:path, node:os, node:child_process, node:crypto, node:readline). The only runtime dependency is commander ^14 (`import { Command } from 'commander'`; `command.opts<T>()`, `command.optsWithGlobals<T>()`). Tests use vitest ^3.2.4 (`import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'`); stub fetch with `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fn)` and restore with `vi.unstubAllGlobals()`. Create temporary directories with `mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'x-'))` and pass `realpathSync` of it (macOS tmp is a symlink).

Existing helpers you may import from cli/src/shared.ts: `resolvePgmConfig(homeDir?)` (credentials, env PGM_API_URL/PGM_API_KEY first, then ~/.pgmrc), `isJsonMode(command)`, `printJson(value)`, `printHuman(lines)`, `handleCliFailure(error, json)`, `shortId(id)`; from cli/src/errors.ts `AppError` and `ErrorCode`. Do not change those files unless this brief says so.

Do not edit the protected feature tests tests/contract/cli-tracking.feature.test.ts, tests/contract/cli-scan.feature.test.ts, changes/004-cli-hooks/slice-check.mjs, specs/constitution.md or specs/constitution.approval.json, nor files of accepted slices unless this brief says so. Do not delete files.

The slice check runs `node changes/004-cli-hooks/slice-check.mjs <files>`: Vitest (with --root cli) on the slice test, ESLint --max-warnings=0 on every listed file, and `tsc --noEmit -p cli/tsconfig.json`. Call the run_checks tool before you finish and fix every reported error. Do not create helper or probe files to run checks; use run_checks.
